text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
——Suu… Fuu… 
Bonjour… Un café, s'il vous plaît…

text_block_list.name: Café Staff
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno!! Cafe-senpai,
you did it! Nice French!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel-sensei must be applauding you
from Japan! Très bien♪

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
I'm glad I did a bit of studying before our
trip. Such a pleasant aroma,
I'm going to go watch their roasting
process.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty then, it's my turn! I'll use the 
power that Laurel-senpai praised me for!

text_block_list.name: Café Staff
text_block_list.text: Ah, next customer, please.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Umm! Ange! D'range! S'il vous plaît!

text_block_list.name: Café Staff
text_block_list.text: Orange juice, Understood.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It actually worked!
They were able to understand my French!

text_block_list.name: Café Staff？
text_block_list.text: Oui, yakisoba bonjour!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huuuh?! Golshi-san?!

text_block_list.name: French Customer
text_block_list.text: Bon Gold Ship! The order isn't ready yet!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Shut it!
Can't you at least come up with some witty
sarcasm?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Old man, did your paintings sell? …Oh,
that's good! 
There's a whole lotta people here today,
huh? Share some tips!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
She fits in so perfectly… I won't fall
behind!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I think she's fitting in too much,
like she's actually Parisian!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But something feels off.
This feeling… something's—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: It's showtime!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I knew it! It's Tap-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wow, she's so elegant.
She's flowing like the Seine River♪

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Hah!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: …And… Finished!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
That was simply a mere greeting!
Now to the main topic… I'm scouting you!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I came to this place to chase a grand
dream! 
Win big or lose everything…a truly outrageous
dream, is it not?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Well,
how about it? A truly compelling prospect,
no? 
Those who feel fired up are all welcome! 
Come on board the ship of pursuit!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I'm in.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Nakayama-san?! When did you get here?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't miss this.
'Lose everything,' huh? 
Like all your assets, reputation,
dignity… everything, right? 
Is that really okay with you?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If it wasn't there'd be no point in risking it,
right? 
I completely agree with that philosophy! 
Earning little by little isn't my thing,
I'm after the big win!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I can get with that.
But we're not allies, 
and we won't be sharing the spoils,
got it?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
But of course! Now then,
who else wants to join us?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'd like to join too!
If it's to fulfill a difficult dream… 
I'll stake the pride of the Satono family
and take the challenge head on!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty then! Romance and strength! 
I'll be the ship's captain!
We're gonna be pirates!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Okay,
but don't forget to drop me off on the way
home! 
It's a little far in a place called Versailles,
but that'll be 
fine, right? Anyway, let's set sail☆

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The sound and aroma of the roasted beans…is
so calming. 
Umm, when you're getting ready to leave you
should say—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Merci". That alone should be enough. 
Yo, Cafe. What a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You're about to leave,
right? Then I'll give you a ride. 
We're heading to the same place after all…

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Monte à bord!
Do you enjoy flying amongst the clouds?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, we finally found you, Cafe-senpai… 
Wait, what's with that expression? 
You look like you just downed a glass of
salsa vida!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wow, she really does!
Want some menthe à l'eau? 
I'll even throw in a manjiro as a Golshi
Special In Paris bonus.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine. I just got off of a small plane
 where the pilot was very…playful.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, did you happen to ride on Sirius-san's
plane?! 
I'm so jealous… I would love to one day
be 
allowed to ride on her plane as well…

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, the young lady's eyes are gleaming,
Sirius. 
I'm also interested in seeing how you handle
your 
plane… So you gonna shoot us an invite?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Comme tu veux. Seems like everything 
is ready. Isn't that right, Tap?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
But there sure are a lot of girls with tricks
up their sleeves. 
That's why this will be an interesting
match… But nonetheless,
I'll be the only one to rise to the top.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Now that's the spirit, Sirius! That's why 
I like you!
You're pursuing the same dream 
with such incredible individuals…
Fantastic.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Now let's start the adventure! 
It'll be a huge, impulsive,
blazing hot adventure!
